messages.author: 88275a537c4bd7d2
messages.subject: RRO 8.0.1 for Mac withdrawn
parts:
We're very sorry, but we've withdrawn for the release of RRO 8.0.1 for Mac. It has problems with loading packages. If you have already installed it, we recommend you uninstall it using these instructions:
http://mran.revolutionanalytics.com/documents/rro/installation/#revorinst-uninstall

The 8.0.0 release is still available here: http://mran.revolutionanalytics.com/archives/

We are investigating why this issue did not arise during our testing process so that it does not happen again. We'll notify you here when the issue is resolved and a new download is available. Thanks to those who reported the problems so promptly.

Again, our apologies for the inconvenience.

# David Smith

Revolution R Plus

messages.author: 88275a537c4bd7d2
messages.subject: Re: RRO 8.0.1 for Mac withdrawn
parts:
Hi David,

We did release an update to 8.0.1 for OS X that fixes the package loading issue. You can download 8.0.1 beta 2 from http://mran.revolutionanalytics.com/download/#download

There is a known issue that affects some packages like igraph (but not, I think, dplyr or ggvis) reporting missing libraries. There's a workaround here:
https://github.com/RevolutionAnalytics/RRO/releases/tag/v8.0.1-beta2

That issues will be addressed in the next RRO release.

Thanks,
# David Smith

messages.author: fd293f6d1c0941b5
messages.subject: Re: RRO 8.0.1 for Mac withdrawn
parts:
Hi David,

I have started using the beta 2 version for the last 2 weeks on my iMac. I have scripts around 1300 lines. Every time I try to open my third script, it opens the choose file window but it got stuck on that screen and about 3 or 4 minutes later RRO crashes with a classical rotating rainbow mouse pointer. It can't even reach the folder that contains my scripts where I also set as my directory. It just got stuck with Documents folder selected and don't even show any folders.

I uninstalled it twice and this is the third time I am using it and this still happens. As a side note, mlogit and systemfit packages are loaded at the background. Don't expect it to be related but just wanted to check.

Let me know if there is a known issue and will just uninstall it and keep using the original R platform.

Thanks,

Necati
